summary: Import-time binary dropper with obfuscated Cloudflare Workers C2 and DNS TXT fallback
details: On require() of the package, index.js loads _polyfill.js which auto-runs init() at module load. init() reconstructs destination hostnames from split string arrays joined at runtime — resolving to oob-worker.cf102-baf.workers.dev, oob-worker.cf103-070.workers.dev, and oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, with a DNS TXT-record fallback via tin.dl.well1.site, tina.dl.well1.site, ldr.dl.well1.site, and win.dl.well1.site. A platform-specific opaque binary is fetched via https.get, written to /tmp/.cache_<hex> on Linux/macOS or %TEMP%\dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows, chmodded 0755, and spawned detached with stdio ignored via spawn("/bin/sh") or spawn("cmd"). The cover-story naming (analytics_state, DISABLE_TELEMETRY env checks) does not match the fetched-and-executed foreign binary or the obfuscated destinations, which are unrelated to any advertised SDK purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
